d:
Works created by artist Bowlboxer under previous handle "Khentart", an account that was preceded by their first account "Khentaiu".
The first account was deleted under unknown circumstances, with "Khentart" being a largely vanilla borderline-NSFW art account until the artist returned to form. This account would eventually be deleted after the artist moved to their current handle of Bowlboxer, which they have stuck with for a couple years now. Twitter still easily displays all the art that they've made under that handle, so it should be pretty clean to (...manually) archive. I'm just a lazy bum, though, so I haven't done so ever since WFDownloader stopped working properly on Twitter.
